faq.hero.lede: Appointments, treatment, privacy and costs — straight answers to the questions patients ask most often.
faq.g1.title: Appointments & visits
faq.g1.q1: Do I need a referral to book an appointment?
faq.g1.a1: No. You can fix a time directly by calling (+880 1716-528757) or emailing us — no referral is needed.
faq.g1.q2: How do I book an appointment?
faq.g1.a2: Call +880 1716-528757, or email dhakapilescarecenter@gmail.com. Share your name, phone number and preferred day, and a time can be arranged.
faq.g1.q3: What should I bring on the first visit?
faq.g1.a3: Bring any earlier reports, prescriptions or medicine packets if you have them. Note down the questions you want to ask — you will get time to ask them during the consultation.
faq.g1.q4: How long does the first visit take?
faq.g1.a4: Usually the first visit is a consultation with the necessary examination — how long it takes varies with each patient's condition, so keeping some extra time in hand is a good idea.
faq.g2.title: Conditions & treatment
faq.g2.q1: If there is bleeding, is it always piles?
faq.g2.a1: No. Bleeding can have several causes — piles, fissure or something else. Because the cause matters, a doctor's examination and evaluation are essential.
faq.g2.a2: No. Depending on the findings, in many cases medicines, diet and lifestyle changes, or simple procedures are enough. What you need is explained after the examination.
faq.g2.q3: Can procedures be done without admission?
faq.g2.a3: Many procedures can be done without hospital admission, where applicable. Which one applies to you is decided after the examination.
faq.g2.a4: Yes, in some cases they can return — which is why follow-up visits and steady food and lifestyle habits matter.
faq.g3.title: Privacy, costs & more
faq.g3.a1: Yes. Consultation, examination and treatment are all handled confidentially. Every patient — woman or man — is heard with dignity.
faq.g3.a2: Costs are explained during the consultation itself, based on your condition and the treatment needed — no price list is published on this website.
faq.g3.q3: Can women also take treatment here?
faq.g3.a3: Of course. The clinic offers confidential, dignified consultation for both women and men.
faq.g3.a4: North Baridhara (near Norda Bus Stand), Dhaka. Call us and we will gladly guide you on how to get there.
faq.cta.d: If your question is not answered here, call or email — fix a time and talk it through in a private consultation.
